articles.summary: - Core deposit growth outpaces robust loan growth; positive operating leverage drives further tangible book value growth - First Business Financial Services, Inc. (the “Company”, the “Bank”, or “First Business Bank”) (Nasdaq: FBIZ) reported quarterly net income available to common shareholders of $16.4 million, or earnings per share ("EPS") of $1.95. This compares to net income available to common shareholders of $15.4 million, or $1.84 per share, in the second quarter of 2026 and $14.2 million, or $1.70 per share, in the third quarter of 2025. “Our record third quarter results reflect strong execution across First Business Bank’s relationship-based model,” said Dave Seiler, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Annualized loan growth of approximately 10% was more than fully funded by 14% annualized core deposit growth, while a strong net interest margin and disciplined expense management drove record pre-tax, pre-provision earnings.
